item.title: GTA 6 Hits 99 on Metacritic, Crowned Best Game Ever in Wave of Rave Reviews
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 has displaced the original Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time as the best video game of all time according to review aggregation site Metacritic . Its Metascore of 99 matches Nintendo's 1998 masterpiece, but is presumably a few decimal points higher behind the scenes.

item.title: 20 Years Later, Paramount's Serial Killer Series Officially Breaks a Weird TV Record
item.description: Gabriel Luna has a rule: He doesn't play villains unless it's opposite "the greatest action hero who's ever lived," aka Arnold Schwarzenegger. "I have an I only play heroes kind of mindset," the actor tells Polygon.

item.title: GTA 6 Officially Launches, Spoiler Warning Issued for Players Still Waiting
item.description: After many long years of waiting and a handful of delays, Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 will finally be released on Thursday, Nov. 19. For some players, it's out right now.

item.title: The GTA 6 Review
item.description: When we first meet the co-star of Grand Theft Auto 6 , she’s scraping the bottom of the cultural barrel. She’s a lowly street rat. The only person who seems to give a damn about her is Jason Duval, another small-time crook who connects with her during a star-crossed carjacking turned meet-cute. It doesn’t take long for the law to interrupt her rom-com dreams, landing her in prison with other low-tier riffraff crammed together like sheep in a pen.

item.title: Gta 6 Won’t Launch Without This PS5 Anti-Piracy Update Sony Just Released
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is the most anticipated release of the past decade, and Sony has been using it as its trump card to encourage players to keep their consoles up to date. If they don't update their console to the latest firmware version, the game simply won't run. GTA 6 is now within our grasp — just a few hours away from release — but gamers won't be able to jump in at launch unless they update their consoles right now.

item.title: The Wachowskis Are Trying to Get The Matrix Back From Skydance
item.description: Twenty-seven years have passed since The Matrix was released in cinemas, changing the entertainment landscape in perhaps more ways than its creators, Lana and Lilly Wachowski, could have envisioned. The Matrix was part of a three-movie deal that the Wachowskis landed with Warner Bros., and the rights to the franchise remained firmly in the hands of the studio, recently absorbed by Skydance in a much-discussed merger. But things may change in the future.

item.title: Macaulay Culkin Officially Returns as Home Alone’s Kevin McAllister
item.description: What's a better way to start getting ready for the festive season than watching Home Alone and Home Alone 2 ? It's a classic, and many of us have grown up watching this heartwarming holiday comedy. It's been 35 years since the first Home Alone premiered, and since then, Macaulay Culkin has played Kevin McCallister several times, mostly for publicity campaigns or skits, like the Google Assistant ad and the short where he plays a tormented Uber driver . It's always great to see him in that role again. This holiday season, Macaulay Culkin returns as Home Alone 's Kevin McCallister in McDonald's latest ad campaign.

item.title: Rings of Power Episode 6 Ending Explained: Amazon Radically Changes the One Ring's Origin Story
item.description: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power season 3 opened with a frightening scene in which Sauron (Charlie Vickers) forges a magical ring. It was a deliberate fakeout (the Orc he tested it on burst into flames) but also a chilling reminder of the inevitable. Sauron is eventually going to forge the One Ring and come into his full power as the Dark Lord of Mordor. But he can’t seem to get it right — yet.

item.title: 8 Funniest 'Far Side' Comics Starring Cowboys
item.description: Gary Larson, the comedy genius behind The Far Side comic strip , loved to turn things into their opposites. Serious, brilliant scientists were cast as childish dummies who drop everything when they hear an ice cream truck pass by. Simple-minded cows could be so smart that they plot the deaths of their owners. As for cowboys, the manly men of the Old West, Larson loved to portray them as meek and cowardly.

item.title: 10 Sci-Fi Books You Need to Read Before At Least Once In Your Life
item.description: Science fiction remains one of storytelling's most expansive playgrounds, capable of charting distant space just as easily as it exposes the imminent horrors of near-future technology. At its peak, sci-fi uses invented technology and distant planets to interrogate what it means to be human, cracking open eternal philosophical questions that more grounded genres simply can’t.
